attributes.description: Which identities operate in which Kibana spaces, across all Kibana traffic. Spaces are shown by id (the /s/<id> in the URL): the audit stream records no space display name. One row per identity: Spaces is how many distinct spaces they touched, named alphabetically in Space list on up to three lines — a longer list ends in “…”, and expanding the row (the expand control at its left) shows all of it. Identities above 1 are the ones worth understanding. Events counts events recorded in a space, so the column can add up to slightly less than all Kibana events: a sign-in (user_login) belongs to no space. An Identity shown as “_4KEO… · Cloud API key” is an organization-level Elastic Cloud API key: the audit stream records it only by its opaque 20-character id, shown here by its first five characters; it has no name and no owner email.

kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON: {"query":{"esql":"SET unmapped_fields=\"nullify\"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-* | WHERE kibana.space.id IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(user.email, api_key.name, user.name, \"<anonymous>\") | STATS events = COUNT(*), spaces = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.space.id), space_list = VALUES(kibana.space.id) BY actor | SORT spaces DESC, events DESC | EVAL space_list = REPLACE(MV_CONCAT(MV_SORT(space_list), \", \"), \"-\", \"-⁠\") | EVAL actor = CASE((LENGTH(actor) == 20 AND actor RLIKE \"[-_A-Za-z0-9]{20}\" AND NOT actor RLIKE \"[0-9]{20}\"), CONCAT(LEFT(actor, 5), \"… · Cloud API key\"), actor) | RENAME actor AS Identity, spaces AS Spaces, space_list AS `Space list`, events AS Events"},"index":{"id":"cloud-audit-adhoc-dv","title":"logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*","timeFieldName":"@timestamp","sourceFilters":[],"type":"esql","fieldFormats":{},"runtimeFieldMap":{},"allowNoIndex":false,"name":"logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-*","allowHidden":false},"filter":[],"highlightAll":true,"version":true}
